steps.title: 6-Axis Small Atmospheric Thruster Perimeter (L2-L3)

partsTray.note: Authored placements only; not a complete BOM.

instructions: **Bow (+Z):** Mount 2× Small Atmo `MUL Lat Fwd 1, 2` facing Forward (exhausts +Z to push Aft) at [X ±1, Z +3, L3].
**Stern (−Z):** Mount 2× Small Atmo `MUL Lat Aft 1, 2` facing Aft (exhausts −Z to push Fwd) at [X ±1, Z −3, L3].
**Port (−X):** Mount 2× Small Atmo `MUL Lat Port 1, 2` facing Port (exhausts −X to push Stbd) at [X −3, Z ±1, L3].
**Starboard (+X):** Mount 2× Small Atmo `MUL Lat Stbd 1, 2` facing Starboard (exhausts +X to push Port) at [X +3, Z ±1, L3].
**Dorsal Roof (+Y):** Mount 2× Small Atmo `MUL Thrust Down 1, 2` facing UP (exhausts +Y to push straight DOWN) at [X ±1, Z 0, L3].
Assign all 10 to terminal group `MUL Maneuver`.
checks: Verify the perimeter maneuvering thrusters face outward as specified and are clear of the skid frame.
